claim: A Newspaper gives 25 Fun, and Fun falls by 20 a day, so reading one Newspaper a day raises Fun by only 5 a day: about 18 days to reach the 90 needed, starting from empty.

evidence.reference: Player post on the Outlanders community Discord, 5 November 2026, shared by the maintainer as a screenshot on 6 November 2026.

notes: Matches the stored values: a Newspaper carries 1 Fun unit, one unit restores 25 points, Fun falls 20 a day, is met at 90 and starts at 0.
